description.value: Bean Around The World is a BC-based specialty coffee chain with a roastery headquartered in North Vancouver; the Courtenay outlet on Cliffe Avenue serves the Comox Valley as one of the chain's Vancouver Island locations. The brand offers a range of coffees, teas, cold brews, and related beverages alongside an online retail operation for beans and brew gear. For cyclists passing through the Comox Valley, it provides a recognisable café anchor on a busy commercial corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms a live Bean Around The World location at 2104 Cliffe Ave, Courtenay with phone 250-871-2771 matching OSM, establishing this as a real, open café. The OSM name 'Been Around The World Café' is a misspelling — the actual brand name is 'Bean Around The World' as shown consistently throughout the website. The location-specific page and broader site contain no mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities, leaving those fields null.
